title: Risk Analyst
description:
Role- Risk Analytics -Audit Analytics 
 Perform data extraction, transformation, profiling and analysis using SQL, Python and ETL tools/techniques. Develop and execute audit analytics, exception testing and risk-based analytical procedures across enterprise processes. Build interactive dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI to communicate analytical findings, exceptions and risk insights. Work with large and complex datasets across modern data platforms such as Databricks and/or Snowflake. Perform data quality checks, reconciliations and validation to ensure the completeness and accuracy of analytical outputs. Translate audit, risk and business requirements into analytical logic, data requirements and test scenarios. Collaborate with Internal Audit, business, technology and data teams to understand processes, identify relevant data sources and deliver analytics. Document data logic, transformation steps, assumptions and analytical procedures to support repeatability and auditability. Support technology-enabled Internal Audit transformation initiatives, including analytics, automation and Continuous Controls Monitoring. Identify opportunities to leverage AI/GenAI and Large Language Models (LLMs) within analytics, audit and risk management use cases. 
 Skills and attributes for success 
 Strong hands-on experience with SQL, including complex queries, joins, aggregations, data profiling and analytical logic. Strong hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, transformation, statistical modelling, automation and development of scalable analytical solutions. Strong understanding of ETL concepts, data transformation and working with data from multiple source systems. Hands-on experience developing dashboards and analytical reporting solutions using Power BI. Experience working with data warehousing and modern data platforms such as Databricks and/or Snowflake. Strong data analysis, reconciliation and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively with large and complex datasets. Ability to understand business, audit and risk requirements and translate them into structured analytical tests and actionable outputs. Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to explain analytical approaches and findings to business and audit stakeholders. Exposure to AI/GenAI solutions and Large Language Models (LLMs) and their application across analytics, audit and risk management. Ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams and manage assigned analytical deliverables. Understand common business and technology processes such as Procure-to-Pay (P2P/PTP), Order-to-Cash (O2C/OTC), Travel & Expense (T&E), ITGC and SOX controls. Have an understanding of risks, controls, KRIs and exception-based audit testing. Have exposure to enterprise systems and datasets such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, expense platforms, GRC tools or other ERP environments. Have experience or exposure to Internal Audit transformation initiatives involving analytics, automation or technology-enabled auditing. We are looking for a hands-on analytics professional who combines strong technical capabilities with an understanding of risk, controls and Internal Audit. You should be comfortable working with complex enterprise datasets, developing analytical solutions independently and translating technical findings into meaningful risk and business insights. You should bring a problem-solving mindset, strong attention to data quality and the ability to collaborate effectively with audit, business, data and technology stakeholders. 

 How to Apply : If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. Make sure you are applying through EY Portal by creating a candidate account. Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits. 
 Link to apply:- https://careers.ey.com/job-invite/1752969/

Key Skills: Inventory,Snowflake,Risk analytics,Python,Auditing,Artificial Intelligence,Data Bricks,SQL
